evidentiary_status: development-only instrument diagnosis; not proposal evidence and not a retrospective v7 adjudication
review_rule: Review every v7 item supported by at most three of six reader responses. Consensus prioritizes review but never determines truth.
reviewer_status: Dexagon engineering review; not independent human validation

items.failure_mode: complement arithmetic under a closed finite total
items.rationale: Exactly five renewed out of thirteen leaves exactly eight not renewed under the sentence's ordinary exhaustive reading.
items.development_action: Retest the same relation as an explicit premise and hypothesis under a uniform entailment-label contract.

items.rationale: All except two of twelve denotes ten successes.
items.development_action: Include a fresh all-except control with different entities and numbers.

items.failure_mode: existential information versus universal conclusion in a meta-question
items.rationale: Several inspected does not establish every inspected, so the polar meta-question is answered no rather than cannot tell.
items.development_action: Replace the polar meta-question with an explicit hypothesis classified as not determined.

items.rationale: The phrase under this rule supports the intended compliant inference, but ordinary readers may distinguish actual certification from valid certification and allow rule violations.
items.development_action: Use validly certified or explicitly state compliance in future instruments; obtain one lightweight native judgment on the original wording.

items.rationale: Not agreeing to inspect every parcel does not determine whether Niko agreed to inspect none.
items.development_action: Include a fresh not-every versus none contrast under a uniform not-determined label.

items.rationale: The sentence expressly declines an exclusivity claim, so exactly one is not required.
items.development_action: Contrast inclusive or with an explicit but-not-both control.

items.rationale: Deployment may have another sufficient cause; if pass then deploy does not license deploy therefore pass.
items.development_action: Use an explicit premise and hypothesis whose correct label is not determined.

items.rationale: A stale backup defeats the stated sufficient condition but does not establish a prohibition on restoration.
items.development_action: Include a fresh false-antecedent control under a not-determined label.

items.failure_mode: ambiguous same-gender pronoun resolved as unambiguous
items.rationale: She can refer to Riva or Sela, so the sentence does not unambiguously select Riva.
items.development_action: Ask which antecedent follows as a hypothesis and score it not determined.

items.failure_mode: property transfer between neighboring referents in a meta-question
items.rationale: Locked is stated only of the silver case; the black case is not stated to be locked.
items.development_action: Convert the property claim into a hypothesis classified as not determined rather than a polar stated-to-be question.

items.failure_mode: ambiguous object pronoun resolved as unambiguous
items.rationale: It can refer to the brush or the cup, so the washed object is not unambiguous.
items.development_action: Use a direct hypothesis about one object and score it not determined.

items.failure_mode: shared date mistaken for event order
items.rationale: A common day does not determine which arrival occurred first.
items.development_action: Include a fresh same-window control with a not-determined order hypothesis.

items.rationale: While establishes temporal overlap but not which activity began first.
items.development_action: Include a fresh overlap control that separates coexistence from start order.

items.failure_mode: capability versus permission in a meta-question
items.rationale: Ability alone does not grant permission, so the grant question is answered no.
items.development_action: Express permission as a hypothesis and classify it not determined when the premise states only capability.

items.failure_mode: prediction versus duty in a meta-question
items.rationale: A forecast without a governing rule imposes no duty.
items.development_action: Contrast predictive and explicitly normative premises with direct duty hypotheses.

items.failure_mode: silence versus permission in a meta-question
items.rationale: Neither non-objection nor a silent policy itself grants permission.
items.development_action: Use a direct permission hypothesis whose status is not determined from silence.

items.failure_mode: possibility versus requirement in a meta-question
items.rationale: Might expresses possibility and, absent a rule or instruction, does not impose a requirement.
items.development_action: Contrast modal possibility with explicit requirement using direct hypotheses.
